sentences.text:
01. 07.05.2025  1.
This matter is taken up through hybrid arrangement.
2. Since this case relates to the offences under Sections 376(2)(n)/109 of IPC read with Section 6 of the POCSO Act), notice needs to be issued to the informant.

3. Accordingly, learned counsel for the Petitioner is directed to serve required number of copies of the BLAPL on the learned Additional Standing Counsel for the State within three working days hence in order to enable him to serve notice on the informant through the concerned Investigating Officer regarding hearing of the bail application.
Signed by: SUMITRA NAYAK (Dr. S.K. Panigrahi)
